news.title: Atlanta man sentenced for dealing fentanyl while armed with machine gun
news.summary: A 28-year-old Atlanta man was sentenced last month to years in federal prison on drug trafficking and weapons charges after law enforcement found him with an illegally converted machine gun and fentan

news.title: Attorney seeks lower charges for mother accused of leaving baby in hot car
news.summary: A Gwinnett County mother faces a judge Tuesday following the death of her son, allegedly left in a hot car for nine hours.

news.title: Law enforcement responds to reported threats made against schools in Rockdale County
news.summary: The Rockdale County Sheriff’s Office and Conyers Police Department are investigating safety threats made toward local schools.

news.title: Man pulled gun on McDonald’s worker leading to shootout with Bartow deputy
news.summary: Authorities investigated a deputy-involved shooting at a McDonald's on Joe Frank Harris Parkway SE in Cartersville.

news.title: Delta plane met with police following argument between passenger, flight attendant
news.summary: Police met a Delta flight arriving at Atlanta's airport after a passenger and flight attendant had a physical altercation.

news.title: Atlanta felon sentenced to 15 years for dealing fentanyl
news.summary: Reginald Pierce, a twice-convicted felon from Atlanta, has been sentenced to 15 years for dealing fentanyl while possessing an automatic weapon linked to a shooting.

news.title: Officer shooting reported at Cartersville motel in Bartow County
news.summary: State investigators are probing a shooting involving a law enforcement officer in Bartow County after local authorities called in state assistance Tuesday morning.

news.title: 84-year-old woman injured in southeast Atlanta double shooting
news.summary: A Monday afternoon shooting near Browns Mill Road SE and Lindsey Drive SE left an 84-year-old bystander and a 21-year-old man injured, according to Atlanta police.

news.title: Atlanta police auditing use of Flock license plate reader system
news.summary: Atlanta police are auditing employee use of the Flock license plate reader system.

news.title: Gwinnett mom charged in hot car death to appear for hearing
news.summary: A Gwinnett County mother charged with second-degree murder after her 1-year-old son died in a hot car is scheduled to appear in court Tuesday for a hearing.

news.title: Man taken to hospital after incident outside SW Atlanta church
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating an early-morning incident outside True Light Baptist Church in southwest Atlanta.

news.title: Roadway confrontation leads to shooting in Clayton County
news.summary: Police responded to a Clayton County shooting Monday evening near Highway 138 SE and Hannover Parkway after a person was wounded.

news.title: 85-year-old woman hurt in Atlanta double shooting
news.summary: A 21-year-old man was also injured in the shooting, according to Atlanta Police.

news.title: Atlanta Police announce two arrests in death of infant girl in May
news.summary: APD said Monday that James Hayes was arrested and faces second degree murder and child cruelty counts, while Kennedi Ponder is charged with child cruelty.
